ISALNUM_L(3) Library Functions Manual ISALNUM_L(3)

NAME

isalnum_l, isalpha_l, isblank_l, iscntrl_l, isdigit_l, isgraph_l, ishexnumber_l, isideogram_l, islower_l, isnumber_l, isphonogram_l, isprint_l, ispunct_l, isrune_l, isspace_l, isspecial_l, isupper_l, isxdigit_l — character classification utilities

LIBRARY

Standard C Library (libc, -lc)

SYNOPSIS

#include <wctype.h>
#include <xlocale.h>

int
isalnum_l(int c, locale_t loc);

int

int

int

DESCRIPTION

These functions are extended locale versions of the corresponding functions, with the _l removed. Also, see xlocale(3) for more information about extended locales.
